292041.q: The Movement expresses its deep concern regarding the termination of UNIFIL ’s mandate by the end of 2026 and the subsequent vacuum that this will create.
292041.prev: It stresses the need to ensure accountability for such attacks.
292041.next: The Movement is of the view that a United Nations presence in Lebanon remains indispensable to observe, monitor and report on the future implementation of resolution 1701 (2006),  and for as long as it takes the Lebanese Army to deploy fully across the entire territory.
